Certificate of Completion of Work
This is to certify that the work of “Process Piping Package — Tamil Nadu Pkg-54” (industrial epc),
awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has
been completed in all respects on 2015-06-06 at a gross executed value of INR 27,05,00,000/- (Rupees 27.05
Crore Only).
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on satisfactory
completion of the final inspection.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Pooja Bose. This certificate is issued for record and for
submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
Executive Engineer
Mahanadi Steel Corporation
